<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 147.00, 133.90, 128.91 (twice), and 127.68 (twice) ppm, all within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110‑160 ppm). Counting each carbon represented by these peaks gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
